capabilities: Add context menu items to images in reading view and on canvas
Copy images and image URLs to the clipboard
Open images in the default app or system explorer
Open images in a new tab (middle click) or new window
Rename image files from the context menu
extras: Formerly named "Copy Image and URL context menu"; the link-URL copying and Open PDF externally features were removed after Obsidian added native equivalents (versions 1.5.2 and 1.9.1). Mobile support was only tested on Android. Credits several contributors and accepts donations via GitHub, Ko-fi, and PayPal.
problem: Obsidian's built-in image menus lack options like copying an image to the clipboard, opening it in the default app or system explorer, or revealing the underlying file in navigation.

relations.evidence: it was a great starting point for working with context menus in Obsidian

summary: Adds right-click context menu items for images in reading view and on canvas, such as copy to clipboard, open in default app, show in system explorer, and rename.
